desc: Analyze problem structure: composition of nondecreasing step functions; precompute answer for every initial rating X via range-add on a monotone array A where A[X] is the final rating.

Implement the difference-array + Fenwick tree solution (Fenwick binary-lifting lower_bound on prefix sums of D to find [lo,hi] per contest, range-add +1, final accumulate) reading stdin and writing stdout.
Verify against all three provided samples plus edge cases (empty interval when A jumps over [L,R], ratings exceeding M, X=1 and X=500000, all contests empty); all 3 public samples PASSED.
Confirm complexity O(N log M + M + Q) time and O(M) memory is within constraints (N=2e5, Q=3e5, values up to 5e5).
